title: Choo-choo train, Qwen3-8B in one call (no build: it loops)
model: Skippy Core's stock Qwen3-8B (Q4), one call with MineBench's own prompt, the way MineBench runs a model
verdict: A failed build, kept. It started reasonably: a train body, an engine, windows and doors drawn as boxes in stone, glass and dirt. Then it fell into a loop, writing the same two block() lines (two stone blocks at the edge of the grid) over and over for 19 minutes until it reached its 28,000-token limit, so its JSON never closed and MineBench would get no build. An 8B model at temperature 0 (the slot's setting for Mentat's routing) is the weakest builder here.
